d: Trinamool Congress leader and Diamond Harbour MP Abhishek Banerjee addressed a press conference strongly refuting allegations following a reported cash seizure of over one crore rupees from a party office in Sarisha. Producing letters and complaint acknowledgements submitted to the local police months earlier, he asserted that the premises had been ransacked and surrendered long ago, during which the party had officially warned authorities about potential conspiracies to plant incriminating evidence. Rebutting the claims, Banerjee stated, 'This evidence was deliberately planted,' alleging…
